identification: Two cardboard trays of boxed diecast models, about 40 pieces. Tray 1: 15 Solido 'Age d'Or' 1:43 vintage-car models in perspex display cases (Cadillac Commercial, Talbot, Rolls-Royce Cabriolet, Ford T-Bird/Thunderbird, delivery vans etc), plus a few boxed modern 1:43 (Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar E-type, a blue car). Tray 2: about 6 Welly NEX 1:36 cars, 3 Collector's Edition (Maisto-type) cars, 2 Jada Transformers 1977 Camaro Bumblebee, 1 Jada Back to the Future DeLorean Time Machine, 1 Bburago, a few others. Mostly budget/modern models. Armitage estimate 30-50, current bid $15.
